protocol.settings: 2000 uniform two-theta degree bins, full pixel splitting, solid angle, polarization0.965, same detector mask and geometry weights; all625frames in file order.
protocol.sampling: Three alternating whole-file passes for h5py/parallel/reusable/fused comparison. Five additional alternating direct paired passes of reusable Dioptrin and fused Jon supply primary optimized numbers. All results and host CPU load retained.
protocol.full_validation: Parallel-decoded Dioptrin and Jon outputs checked against all625h5py-derived Dioptrin outputs. Direct paired625-frame Jon/reusable-Dioptrin results checked independently in each error mode. Sampled uncompressed versus compressed decoding also checked.
protocol.setup_excluded: HDF5 chunk-index discovery, calibration/LUT/plan initialization, mmap opening and initial buffer allocation. h5py stream opens its dataset inside each timed pass. Fixed calibration/mask reused for every frame.
protocol.cache: No cache purge. Every workflow is warmed with a full625-frame pass before timing. Includes file-backed accesses, decoding, orientation conversion where needed, integration, normalization and output allocation/materialization. Not cold-device I/O or first-file initialization.
protocol.precision: Jon coefficient storage is float32; Dioptrin is float64. Poisson Jon adapter stacks signal and squared-weight rows; Dioptrin accumulates variance in its integration traversal. Both use identical exported float64 normalization.
protocol.scope: Dioptas remains unchanged. These are measured input-pipeline prototypes, not a new native HDF5 API shipped by Dioptrin.

file_reading_protocol.h5py: Open dataset and read/decode each frame, flip/convert to float64 inside timed producer; integrate via streaming batch.
file_reading_protocol.parallel_decode: Read chunks through read-only mmap, decode in eight threads, allocate flipped float64 frames, integrate bounded groups32.
file_reading_protocol.reusable_decode: Same chunk decoder, per-thread uint32 buffers and eight reusable float64 frames; all read/decode/convert/integration timed.
file_reading_protocol.jon: Read chunks from the same mapping, fused bitshuffle-LZ4 decode plus CSC integration, float32 weights and float64 output/normalization.
file_reading_protocol.setup_excluded: HDF5 chunk-index discovery, calibration/LUT/plan construction, opening the raw mmap, sampled validation and buffer allocation before the timed passes.
file_reading_protocol.cache: Warm/repeated whole-file passes; OS page cache is not flushed. Physical cold-disk bandwidth is not measured.
file_reading_protocol.decode_control: Reading mapped chunks, decompressing to uint32 and flipping/copying to reusable float64; no integration. Optional diagnostic, not an integration result.
